memory_candidates.content: CSLib extension PR workflow pattern: The /pr command for cslib uses command-only architecture (no separate skill) due to requiring 4+ interactive AskUserQuestion gates. Input modes: task number (integer), path (contains /), free-text description. CI pipeline is 7 steps: lake build, checkInitImports, lint, lint-style (--fix available), test, mk_all (conditional on new .lean files), shake (--fix available). PR target is always leanprover/cslib with --base main via gh pr create. Fork model: origin=benbrastmckie/cslib, upstream=leanprover/cslib.
